digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and completion-verifier workflow duration measurement
propositions: Measure empirical p50, p90, and p99 wall-clock durations for plan-review and gated-close completion-verifier workflows using tracker sidecars and terminal rollout logs.

Establish reproducible populations with explicit inclusion filters (post-fix provider-clean rows, positive LLM calls, non-interrupted completed runs) and report sample sizes, observation windows, and percentile method.
Compute padded expectation intervals as 1.2× (p50 through p90) separately for each operation and propose rounded guidance wording.

Identify and document known performance contributors: pre-verifier scanning, ticket-snapshot construction, and completion-agent workflow, with sensitivity analysis across full-window and current-regime cohorts.
Resolve concurrent shared-lock contention as intended behavior per documented concurrency model, not a defect requiring code changes.
Present final statistics and proposed guidance to operator and await explicit confirmation before modifying agent-guidance documentation.
